Amarnath Yatra Resumes After Six-Day Weather Suspension

The Amarnath Yatra has resumed after a six-day suspension due to rain damage on the Pahalgam route. The Baltal route remained open. Over 6,000 pilgrims departed from Jammu. The Lieutenant Governor reviewed repair work along the Yatra tracks. The Northern Army Commander also reviewed security arrangements in Kashmir.
